newsitem.title: SPAIN: BBV rockets on 27.5 pct 5-mo profit rise.
newsitem.headline: BBV rockets on 27.5 pct 5-mo profit rise.

text.p: Shares in Spain's BBV bank outpaced the indices on Thursday after it said its five months to May attributable profit rose 27.5 percent, dealers said.
At 1045 GMT, BBV shares were up 190 pesetas, 1.7 percent, to 11,350. The Ibex blue chip index rose 0.89 percent to 6,678.88.

"These figures are very good. I still think that banks are one of the sectors most likely to outperform this year. BBV is a clear buy option at these levels," said a dealer at Benito y Monjardin brokerage.
He set a medium term target price of 14,000 pesetas.
But a trader at a Spanish bank said that although interest may have been raised by the news, the figures were in line with an expected strong performance from the bank.
"I think it was pretty well-expected and although the shares may have moved a little better, so has the market in general. But certainly...it's an obvious (buy) target at these levels."

BBV said attributable profit for the five months to May rose 27.5 percent to 48.12 billion pesetas, and confirmed a three for one share split, to take place on July 19 and a cancellation of one percent of its treasury stock.
